primary_content.text: Book before 31st of July and train anytime until 31st December 2026 and get 20% OFF All-Inclusive Training + Standard Accommodation.
are you ready ? For the training experience of your life!
Book before 31st of July and train anytime until 31st December 2026 and get 20% OFF All-Inclusive Training + Standard Accommodation.

At Tiger Muay Thai and MMA training camp, Phuket, Thailand, we believe you should be able to pay the same training prices for Muay Thai as you would anywhere else in Thailand, so we keep our prices low and our training standard high.

Children under 12 will be given 50% off of group training (access to martial arts based classes only) for single class, week, month. Expat children (living in Thailand) 12 and under will be given 50% off of minimum month group training. However, children are required to be under supervision at all times by a parent or a legal guardian.

To Thai Nationals, Working Expats, and Retirees residing in Thailand, Please inquire at TMT front office or email [email protected] regarding TMT Membership rates. Please note you need to present your Thai National ID, Certified/Original Work Permit or Retirement Visa.
7% VAT is not included in the prices listed. Prices and availability subject to change without notice.

row_cells.text: All-Inclusive Training This option allows access to ALL and ANY of classes that Tiger offers. This has the most flexibility, you can mix and match classes to take advantage of everything the camp has to offer. This is highly recommended for camp guests that want to try a bit of everything.
Muay Thai Training This option gives you access to all our Muay Thai, Western Boxing, Krabi Krabong and Muay Boran classes + weight room access.
Muay Thai & MMA Training This option gives you access to all Muay Thai, MMA, BJJ/Grappling, Kickboxing, Western Boxing, Muay Boran, Krabi Krabong and Yoga classes + weight room access.
Grappling & BJJ Training This option gives you access to all our Grappling & BJJ classes and the MMA Wrestling only classes + weight room access.
Western Boxing & Fitness Training This option includes access to our Western Boxing classes and all our Fitness classes, including weight room access and Yoga classes.
Fitness Training This option gives you access to all our Fitness classes, Off-Site Boot-camps training sessions and Yoga classes + weight room access.
DELUXE Training Pack This pack gives you access to ALL our classes and the weight-room + the addition of 25 Private Muay Thai sessions a month (7 per week).
VIP Training Pack This pack gives you access to ALL our classes and the weight-room + the addition of 50 Private Muay Thai sessions a month (12 per week).
Muay Thai Privates 1 hour 1-on-1 Mauy Thai private session with the trainer of your choice. Private Sessions are 1 hour and includes stretching, warm-up, hand wrap, and training plan.
Basic All-Inclusive Package STANDARD This package gives you access to all our classes and accommodation in one of our STANDARD accommodations and pre-paid meal card for the duration of your choice.
Basic All-Inclusive Package PLUS Same as the above Basic All-Inclusive Package STANDARD but with DELUXE accommodation (with pool access).
Basic All-Inclusive Package PREMIUM Same as the above Basic All-Inclusive Package STANDARD but with PREMIUM accommodation (with direct pool access).

Deluxe All-Inclusive Package STANDARD This package gives you access to all our classes, accommodation in one of our STANDARD accommodations and pre-paid meal card for the duration of your choice + the addition of 25 Private Muay Thai sessions a month (7 per week).
Deluxe All-Inclusive Package PLUS Same as the above Deluxe All-Inclusive Package STANDARD package but with DELUXE accommodations (with pool access).
Deluxe All-Inclusive Package PREMIUM Same as the above Deluxe All-Inclusive Package PLUS package but with PREMIUM accommodations (with direct pool access).

VIP All-Inclusive Package STANDARD This package gives you access to all our classes, accommodation in one of our STANDARD accommodations and pre-paid meal card for the duration of your choice + the addition of 50 Private Muay Thai sessions a month (12 per week).
VIP All-Inclusive Package PLUS Same as the above VIP All-Inclusive Package STANDARD package but with DELUXE accommodations (with pool access).
VIP All-Inclusive Package PREMIUM Same as the above VIP All-Inclusive Package PLUS package but with PREMIUM accommodations (with direct pool access)

Weight-Loss All-Inclusive Package STANDARD This package gives you access to all our classes, accommodation in one of our STANDARD accommodations and a pre-paid meal card for the duration of your choice. It also includes a supplement pack , a 1-on-1 consultation and 12 Private Fitness sessions a month (3 per week).
Weight-Loss All-Inclusive Package PLUS Same as the above STANDARD Weight-Loss All Inclusive package but with DELUXE accommodation with Pool Access.
Weight-Loss All-Inclusive Package PREMIUM Same as the above PLUS Weight-Loss All Inclusive package but with PREMIUM accommodation with direct Pool Access.
STANDARD Accommodation Includes large bed, AC, wi-fi internet, TV, fridge, private bathroom with toilet and hot water shower, wardrobe, seating area and more.
DELUXE Accommodation With pool access, includes large bed, AC, wi-fi internet, TV, fridge, microwave, hairdryer, private bathroom with toilet and hot water, wardrobe, seating area and more.
PREMIUM Accommodation With DIRECT pool access just out of the room in addition to everything out Deluxe accommodation has.
Tiger Hillside Pool Villas - 1 Bedroom Includes 1 large bed, wardrobe, AC, wi-fi internet, TV, fridge, microwave, hairdryer and private bathroom with toilet and hot water.
Tiger Hillside Pool Villas - 2 Bedroom Includes 1 large bed and 1 single bedroom, wardrobe, AC, wi-fi internet, kitchen, fridge, microwave, hairdryer, private bathroom with toilet and hot water.

Tiger Money Card Tiger Money Card will replace the cash and the hassle from carrying cash on you at all times. Plus, an additional value of 6,000 THB ($200) FREE upon activation. You can now swipe your 'Tiger Money card' for services like extended training, Private sessions, meal top-ups and for any purchases at the gear shop. 200$ FREE
Prepaid Meal Cards Convenient prepaid meal cards. Be in control of your spending limit during your stay at TMT.

Muay Thai Gear Package Discounted package with TMT Branded Gear containing: 1x Muay Thai Gloves. 1x Shinpads, 2x Handwraps, 2x T-Shirts or Tank-Tops, 2x Muay Thai shorts, 1x Small Sweat Towel, 1x Mouthguard

MMA Gear Package Discounted package with TMT Branded Gear containing: 1x Muay Thai Gloves. 1x Shinpads TMT, 1x MMA Gloves TMT, 1x Rashguard, 2x Handwraps, 2x T-Shirts or Tank-Tops, 2x MMA Shorts, 1x Small Sweat Towel, 1x Mouthguard

Traditional Thai Massage & Oil Massage Combo Traditional Thai Massage or Oil Massage, 10 hours (recommended: 10 x 60-minute sessions). Ideal for ongoing relaxation and recovery. Choose Thai Massage for stretching and tension relief, or Oil Massage for a gentle, soothing experience. Hours can be mixed and matched and shared with friends and family.

Traditional Thai Massage or Oil Massage & Sport Massage Combo Chosose between either Traditional Thai or Oil Massage and Sport Massage (choose per session), 10 hours (recommended: 10 x 60-minute sessions). Perfect for athletes and active clients who need deeper recovery and targeted therapy. Mix relaxing treatments with sport massage sessions as needed. Hours can be mixed and matched and shared with friends and family.

Sport, Aroma or Gold Hot & Oil Massage Combo Choose between Hot Sport Massage, Hot Oil Massage,
Hot Aroma Oil Massage, or Gold Oil Massage (choose per session), 10 hours (recommended: 10 x 60-minute sessions). Perfect for athletes and active individuals, as well as
anyone seeking deep relaxation.
Pre-pay your airport pickup, price difference is due to different size vehicles being required.
Single Class (drop-ins only) For the people that just want to do one class here and another class there from time to time. Only available at the camp.
Day Pass (drop-ins only) A Day Pass will give you full access to the facility, weight-room included and be able to participate in all classes for a whole day. Only available at the camp.
